course.title: Unit 6 A Day in the Life【例句】
course.description: SECTION B How different are people's daily routines?

sentences.content: My name is Timo Halla.
sentences.english: My name is Timo Halla

sentences.content: I'm 13 years old.
sentences.english: I'm 13 years old

sentences.content: I live with my parents in Helsinki, Finland.
sentences.english: I live with my parents in Helsinki , Finland

sentences.content: Every Tuesday, I usually get up at 7:40.
sentences.english: Every Tuesday , I usually get up at 7:40

sentences.content: I often listen to the news or music.
sentences.english: I often listen to the news or music

sentences.content: After breakfast, I walk to school.
sentences.english: After breakfast , I walk to school

sentences.content: It's only a 10-minute walk.
sentences.english: It's only a 10-minute walk

sentences.content: My school begins at 9:00.
sentences.english: My school begins at 9:00

wordDetails.definition: begin（第三人称单数）: 开始

sentences.content: There are 18 students in my class.
sentences.english: There are 18 students in my class

sentences.content: Each lesson is 45 minutes long, and there's a break between lessons.
sentences.english: Each lesson is 45 minutes long , and there's a break between lessons
sentences.chinese: 每节课时长为45分钟，课间有休息时间。

sentences.content: I have one Finnish lesson and two home economics lessons in the morning.
sentences.english: I have one Finnish lesson and two home economics lessons in the morning
sentences.chinese: 我上午有一节芬兰语课和两节家政课。

sentences.content: After that, I have lunch at 12:00.
sentences.english: After that , I have lunch at 12:00

sentences.content: The afternoon lessons begin at 12:30 and finish at 2:15.
sentences.english: The afternoon lessons begin at 12:30 and finish at 2:15
sentences.chinese: 下午的课程从12:30开始，到2:15结束。

sentences.content: Then I go to my ice hockey club.
sentences.english: Then I go to my ice hockey club
sentences.chinese: 然后我去参加我的冰球俱乐部活动。

sentences.content: I usually get home around 4:00.
sentences.english: I usually get home around 4:00

sentences.content: It's already dark outside.
sentences.english: It's already dark outside

sentences.content: I often have dinner at 6:00.
sentences.english: I often have dinner at 6:00

sentences.content: After that, I read with my parents for an hour.
sentences.english: After that , I read with my parents for an hour
sentences.chinese: 之后，我和父母一起阅读了一个小时。

sentences.content: That's an important part of my everyday life.
sentences.english: That's an important part of my everyday life
sentences.chinese: 这是我日常生活中重要的一部分。

sentences.content: Then I prepare my schoolbag for the next day.
sentences.english: Then I prepare my schoolbag for the next day
sentences.chinese: 然后我为第二天准备好书包。

sentences.content: At 9:30, it's time for me to go to bed.
sentences.english: At 9:30 , it's time for me to go to bed
